Latin word

jaceō

jaceō, jacēre, jacuī

verb, second conjugation

lie (of a place); be downcast, be dejected; to lie low, be downcast; lie, be lying (down)

In this lexicon

  • be located

    also used · classical · Traupman 204

  • depress

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 7.21.1: Gnaeus noster ut tōtus jacet (Lewis & Short s.v. jaceō); Traupman 306

  • downhearted

    also used · classical · Traupman 151

  • lie

    the recommended word · classical · Sen. Ep. 87.2: culcita in terrā jacet, ego in culcitā; Liv. 21.4.7: humī jacentem

Examples

  • culcita in terrā jacet, ego in culcitā

    the mattress lies on the ground, and I lie on the mattressSen. Ep. 87.2
